eudi_e1_e3.interpretation: H-EUDI-03 remains supported only as an executable-image detachment mechanism.

eudi_e5.interpretation: On the actual Frank Hostinger body under frankrunner uid 1000, the one-writable-inode layout loses the straightforward POSIX immutable-root boundary available to a split layout. This is direct target-VPS counterevidence against naive H-EUDI-05.

architecture_effect: NO_PROMOTION; EUDI now has simultaneously one supported mechanism and one verified target-VPS security deficit.
required_resolution: Any EUDI candidate must demonstrate a lower-level bounded-write/confinement mechanism that prevents mutable-state authority from addressing immutable root/model bytes, or strict one-file EUDI should be rejected in favor of split layout.
